_comment: Scene layout config - Asset/Layout member edits this file
_guide: No code knowledge needed. Change numbers to adjust placement.
position: [X, Y, Z]  X=left/right, Y=up/down, Z=forward/back (minus = closer)
rotation: [X, Y, Z]  Rotation in degrees on each axis
scale:    [X, Y, Z]  Size multiplier (1.0 = original size)
color:    Hex color code e.g. '#ff0000' = red

staticObjects._comment: Floor plane (hidden in AR passthrough mode)

weapon._comment: Weapon model settings. Adjust xr / desktop separately.
weapon._note: Converting FBX to GLB (Blender: File > Export > glTF 2.0) improves load speed.

xr._tip: If gun faces wrong way, adjust rotation Y in 90-degree increments

desktop._comment: Desktop FPS view (attached to camera, lower-right)
desktop._tip: Adjust position X to move left/right, Y for up/down, Z for distance
